captures.caption: Desk, light. Design: tsk-16 with nothing agreed. Two offered rows (dashed box, muted words, the attempt that offered them), Keep and Drop on each, Offered 2 and Keep all, the add field last. Beside it, Today: Today, his live build: the two offers as ordinary to-dos with “Proposed” before their words, counted in To-dos 0/2. / Today, main: the two offers under an Offered head below the add field, out of the count, with no way to keep or drop them.
